items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: That little boy about my size named George Washington was playing trombone.

ctx.x: And he was on the cornet.
On the cornet. Uh-huh. That little boy about my size named George Washington was playing trombone.
Oh, yeah. I remember hearing about you. George Washington. He played with Buddy Petit. Yeah, Buddy Petit. He's in that picture that's taken.
